rules: Be kind. No harassment, hate speech, threats or bullying of any player.
No cheating. Hacked clients, exploits, duplication glitches and unfair mods are not allowed. Report bugs instead of using them.
Keep chat friendly for everyone. No spam, advertising other servers or sharing other people's private information.
Respect other players' homes and land. No griefing, stealing or building to annoy your neighbours.
Trade honestly. Scamming players out of items, coins or Crowns is not allowed.
One account per person in events and leaderboards. Do not use extra accounts to farm rewards.
Names, guild names, plot names and builds must be appropriate for all ages.
Follow the directions of staff. If you think a decision is wrong, talk to us on Discord.
Breaking these rules can lead to a warning, a mute, a timed ban or a permanent ban, without refund of any money spent.
